title: GHL connection
subtitle: Connect Academy directly to GoHighLevel (no n8n). With the token and sub-account, completing a challenge applies its tag to the contact in GHL.
notAllowed: Only an administrator can manage the GoHighLevel connection.
loadError: Could not load the GHL connection status.
help: The token identifies your GHL account; the sub-account (location) ID tells which account contacts go to. The tag each contact receives is the challenge key (for example “bienvenido-1”); trigger your GHL workflows off that tag.
tokenLabelOptional: GHL API token (leave blank to keep the current one)
tokenUnchangedPlaceholder: •••••••• (saved — type a new one to rotate)
locationHelp: Default sub-account the token is verified against.
saved: Connection saved. Test the connection to verify it.
deleteDialogDesc: You are about to delete the saved token and sub-account. Challenges will stop sending tags to GHL until you save a new connection.
bannerUnverified: Saved but unverified — use Test connection to confirm the token works.
bannerNone: No GHL connection — challenges do not send tags to GoHighLevel.
